interpretationLimits: Node CPU sampling changes execution cost; these instrumented wall times are not an unprofiled performance comparison.
One successful fixture cannot establish the cause of full compiler self-emission cost or a universal speedup.
Time deltas are attributed to sampled leaf frames; inclusive rows overlap and must not be added. V8 inlining/JIT and native builtins limit source-level attribution.
The unchanged --host worker disables detailed error-presentation exports. Both successful gates and exact output identity are reported explicitly.
GC sample share indicates VM time observed in GC; it does not by itself identify allocation sources or peak retained memory.

guardedDirectCalls.retained: Live global lookup, argument evaluation order, arity/bound guards, forcing and stack-safe tails

guardedPositionalWorkers.retained: Code/environment/arity/identity guards and original tail trampoline

priorInterventions.limitation: Different historical artifact and tree/IO workload; these results nevertheless rule out presenting the unchanged guarded-call ablation as a new justified experiment.

nextExperiment.hypothesis: B1 String.cmp character splitting, recursive comparison and tuple reconstruction perform avoidable work independently of the prior call-dispatch transforms.
nextExperiment.distinctFromPrior: Prior guarded direct/positional calls preserved the comparison algorithm and its results; this probe would attribute comparison operation counts and representation costs.
nextExperiment.firstStep: Count calls, compared code points and equal-prefix lengths on a frozen input and isolate the comparison component before a disposable implementation variant.
nextExperiment.oracle: Exact original returned strings and ordering results for empty/prefix, BMP/astral, and malformed UTF-16 cases; preserve character ordering rather than substituting JS code-unit order. Then exact emitted-byte and execution equality.
nextExperiment.measurement: Fresh unprofiled processes only after correctness gates; profile percentages are not an attainable speedup promise.
nextExperiment.notAuthorizedHere: No new experiment, compiler change, runtime change or guard elimination is performed in this report.
